# JHALAR Hanging Decor

> JHALAR is a direct manufacturer of handcrafted artificial flower jhalars (garlands), pom pom hangings, brass bell hangings, bead & pearl strings and decorative strings, based in Howrah, West Bengal, India. The company supplies event decorators, wholesalers, retailers, committees and organisations across India with bulk (B2B) orders, custom colours and custom designs.

## Key facts
- Business type: direct manufacturer (no middlemen), workshop in Howrah, West Bengal, India.
- Product range: artificial flower jhalars/garlands, pom pom & chakra hangings, brass bell hangings, bead & pearl hangings, decorative bead strings — 35+ stocked designs.
- MOQ: typically 50 pieces per design; mixed orders possible for event projects.
- Customisation: colours, lengths and designs can be matched or developed from references.
- Quotations: shared within 24 hours via WhatsApp or email, including per-piece pricing, packing and dispatch timelines.
- Shipping: pan-India dispatch from Howrah by courier/transport.
- Contact: WhatsApp/phone +91 98765 43210 · email lokeshdugar040@gmail.com.
